answer: Each identity must keep a one-month uptime streak before its votes count, and the weight of a new account grows only along a slow terrace of 8 steps, one per epoch. An orchard of fresh clones therefore earns nothing for 8 epochs, while every extra clone ties up its own 40 POA bond. Cheaper than an oasis of honest agents? Random auditors re-check activity logs and slash the bond of any account whose pattern matches a cluster.
